messages:
jamie: Thinking of doing a small PS5 + Switch + Steam LAN meetup at my place next Saturday. Rooftop common room, casual. Who's in?

alex: Count me in. I can bring my PS5 and a docked Switch. :controller:

ravi: Might swing by with my gaming laptop. Do we need to worry about NAT/port forwarding for Steam LAN?

jamie: Good question. If anyone wants to host Steam LAN for older titles, easiest is to use Steam's LAN mode or Hamachi, but I can also forward.

lina: I have a spare 8-port gigabit switch and a handful of Cat6s. Also a power strip.

alex: Also got a PS5 DualSense + charging station I can bring.

ravi: For the PC crowd, SteamCMD quick note if someone wants a dedicated server for, say, CS1.6 or older games: 
```
steamcmd +login anonymous +force_install_dir ./cs_server +app_update 90 validate +quit
```

jamie: Nice. We're aiming for 5pm start, snacks at 6. Rooftop has a fridge, but bring coolers if you want beers. No loud music after 10pm per building rules.

lina: Food prefs? I'll pick up a couple of vegetarian pies and some snacks. Any allergies?

alex: I'm gluten-free, thanks.

ravi: Quick poll: React with one emoji for what you most want to play first - :kart: Mario Kart, :smash: Smash, :cozy: Cozy indie party, :retro: Retro emulation

jamie: :kart:

lina: :retro:

alex: :smash:

streambot: Poll update 13 Mario Kart 1, Smash 1, Retro 1

jamie: Also if anyone has a capture card or wants to stream a short highlights reel, shout now. Lina can stream but needs a capture if we do console gameplay.

lina: I can stream Switch footage via a borrowed USB capture. If someone else can bring one as backup that would be ideal.

ravi: I can bring an Elgato Mini if needed.

alex: Parking is tight at the building, so think about carpooling or coming by transit. Rooftop elevator can be slow; if you have heavy gear we can unload at loading dock.

jamie: Final checklist: label gear, bring adapters (HDMI-C, HDMI-mini), and small extension cords. See you Saturday 5pm! :party_parrot:
